table.retrieve:
SELECT  saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
		 CustomerRef = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo, 
       date = dbo.saleledger.date, 
       invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc, 
       flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
       misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
       invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,
       remarks = dbo.saleledger.remarks,
		 looseqty = dbo.saledetail.looseqty, 
		 packqty  = saledetail.packqty,  
       price = dbo.saledetail.saleprice, 
       itemdiscperc = dbo.saledetail.discperc, 
		 packunits = dbo.saledetail.packunits, 
		 batch = dbo.saledetail.batch, 
		 expiry = dbo.saledetail.expiry, 
		 salestax  = saledetail.salestax,
	 	 itemname = item.name,
		 datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
		 Person = dbo.accounts.name 
FROM 	 dbo.saleledger, 
		 dbo.saledetail,    
		 dbo.item, 
		 dbo.accounts 
WHERE  dbo.saleledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		 dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and 
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = :al_CustCode  and 
		 dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode NOT IN (select distinct srledger.saleinvcode from srledger where srledger.date between :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate and srledger.saleinvcode IS NOT NULL) and
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
		 dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode and 
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode 
UNION ALL
SELECT saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
		 CustomerRef = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo, 
       date = dbo.saleledger.date, 
       invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc, 
       flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
       misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
       invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,
       remarks = dbo.saleledger.remarks,
		 looseqty = sd.looseqty, 
		 packqty  = 0,  
       price = sd.saleprice, 
       itemdiscperc = sd.discperc, 
		 packunits = sd.packunits, 
		 batch = sd.batch, 
		 expiry = sd.expiry, 
		 salestax  = 0,
	 	 itemname = item.name,
		 datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
		 Person = dbo.accounts.name 
FROM 	 dbo.saleledger, 
		 dbo.saleinvdetail sd,    
		 dbo.item, 
		 dbo.accounts 
WHERE  DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND 
		 dbo.saleledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		 dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and 
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = :al_CustCode  and 
		 dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode NOT IN (select distinct srledger.saleinvcode from srledger where srledger.date between :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate and srledger.saleinvcode IS NOT NULL) and
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
		 sd.icode = item.icode and 
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode

objects.name: c_totalmisccharges
objects.expression: sum(  flatdisc for all Distinct  misccharges  )

objects.name: c_totaldisc
objects.expression: sum(  flatdisc for all Distinct  saleinvcode  )

objects.name: c_totalamount
objects.expression: Round(sum(  c_amount for all ) + sum(misccharges for all distinct   saleinvcode ) - sum(flatdisc for all distinct   saleinvcode ), 0)

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round((  looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) , 2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round ( Sum((  looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) For Group 1 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)
